target.title: fix(agent-core): keep file info basename on Windows paths
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users inspecting files through the agent harness on Windows would see `FileInfo.name` include parent directories when the addressed path used Windows separators.

## Why This Change Was Made

`NodeExecutionEnv` now derives file metadata names with platform-appropriate separators at the shared `fileInfoFromStats` boundary used by `fileInfo()` and `listDir()`. The fix stays local to agent-core file metadata and avoids changing POSIX handling, where backslashes can be valid filename characters.

## User Impact

Windows harness file metadata now reports stable basename-only names, so callers can display or compare file entries without carrying the full parent path in `name`.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: Windows-style addressed paths now produce basename-only `FileInfo.name` values through `NodeExecutionEnv.fileInfo()`.
- Current-head proof at `5c6fcd827a4220274f446a6411b1bda2f49685b8`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/agent-core/src/harness/env/nodejs.test.ts` passed on this PR branch.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Observed result: the focused regression exercises `NodeExecutionEnv.fileInfo("C:\\workspace\\notes\\todo.txt")` under Windows platform semantics and observes `FileInfo.name === "todo.txt"`.
